## Summary

Describe the problem, your change and any related issue.

## Verification

Describe the checks you ran, including `npm run check`.
For visual changes, include representative stills or a clearly labeled preview.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and directly related documentation is updated.
- [ ] Behavior changes have focused tests where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or generated media are committed.
- [ ] Reel changes follow the production instructions, with review flags reset
      after content or voice changes (or this does not change a reel).
